headlines.title: Axon Sinks 27% in a Week to a New 52-Week Low. Is the Selling Overdone?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAxon shares fell 27% in a week to a new 52-week low after a revenue miss and a lower 2026 outlook. Delayed federal Dedrone deployments drove the cut, while Motorola Solutions and Tyler Technologies point to healthy demand.

headlines.title: Axon Is Down 52% From Its August High. Northland Still Sees $540
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAxon shares closed at $313 on Nov. 6, down 52% from their August high, after a third-quarter revenue miss and a guidance cut tied to about $130 million of delayed federal counter-drone deployments.

headlines.title: Axon Enterprise: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
headlines.summary: Axon's $15.8 billion in future contracted bookings gives the company a multi-year runway, but its inventory buildup is already weighing on free cash flow.

headlines.title: Axon's Connected Devices Unit Gains Momentum: Can It Sustain?
headlines.summary: AXON's strong demand for TASER 10 and body cameras fuels growth, but federal Dedrone project delays weigh on its 2026 revenue outlook despite solid momentum.

headlines.title: AXON Q3 2026 deep dive: large drone investment and federal deal delays shape outlook
headlines.summary: Self defense company AXON (NASDAQ:AXON) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 27.8% year on year to $908.6 million. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1 billion underwhelmed, coming in 6.8% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.72 per share was 9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

description: Axon Enterprise, Inc. provides public safety technology solutions in the United States and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Software and Services, and Connected Devices. The Software and Services segment develops, manufactures, and sells cloud-based software-as-a-service solutions to capture, store, manage, share, and analyze video and other digital evidence. This segment also offers Axon Evidence, Draft One, Axon Records, Axon Standards, Axon Fusus, Axon Assistant, and others. The Connected Devices segment engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of integrated hardware solutions, such as conducted energy devices under the TASER brand, body cameras, fixed and in-car cameras, drone and counter-drone technologies, accessories, extended warranties, and related hardware products, as well as virtual reality training hardware. The company serves first responders across international, federal, state, and local governments, international governmental entities, commercial enterprises, and consumers through direct sales, distribution partners, and third-party resellers. The company was formerly known as TASER International, Inc. and changed its name to Axon Enterprise, Inc. in April 2017. Axon Enterprise, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona.
